skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK Direct DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Gains [Damage Immunity] on self (takes only 20% of incoming DMG) and Dispels his own debuffs. Applies [Undying-Suppression] to the target's entire column, then deals HP-scaling Direct DMG equal to 35% ATK plus [True DMG] to that column.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: [Damage Immunity] on self becomes total — incoming DMG taken 20% > 0%. HP-scaling Direct DMG 35% > 45% ATK.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: On entry, gains +20% HP and +60% Non-Crit DMG Free, and gains [Revenge+] (revives up to 4 times).

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Grants himself [Vengeance]. ———- [Vengeance]: If Drive Knight is defeated after any character acts, revives with 80% HP. and launches [Vengeance Follow-up] (150% of Ultimate DMG, does not use energy). Has 4 times of [Revival] at the start of the battle.

effects.desc: The bearer only takes a portion (e.g. 20%, or 0% when enhanced) of all damage taken.
Status returns downed units to battle, granting a limited number of respawns that anti-revive effects can remove.
This type of bonus damage is dealt on top of attacks, is reduced by Evasion-type effects, and can be immune after a certain number of turns.
The counterattack state can extend the duration on yourself or shorten it on enemies, granting retaliatory effects.
